Our Team

Voxela is a Silicon Valley-based technology company founded by serial entrepreneurs Yuta Endo,
Goutham Kamath, and Yusuke Yoshida.
Inspired by interviewing over 100 caregivers, the company reinvented the future of eldercare.
Voxela's mission is to empower technology and caregivers to collaborate seamlessly, ensuring that everyone receives the exceptional care they deserve.
